name: agent-prose
description: Writing-craft toolkit for coding agents: poems and song lyrics, game dialogue and barks, user instructions and docs, academic and professional prose, sitcom, TV drama, stage plays, YouTube scripts and speeches, drafted in native formats, measured and linted against cited craft rules. Eleven skills: prose-setup, prose-dialog, prose-script, prose-speech, prose-instruct, prose-formal, prose-comedy, prose-voice, prose-review, prose-poetry, prose-songwriting. Variant sets let the owner choose between measurably different rewrites.
